sources.title: bge
sources.snippet: The BGE series models have gained widespread popularity among users and developers due to excellent performance and applicability, with download data far surpassing that of similar models.

sources.title: BAAI/bge-m3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BGE-M3 (paper, code) In this project, we introduce BGE-M3, which is distinguished for its versatility in Multi-Functionality, Multi-Linguality, and Multi-Granularity. Multi-Functionality: It can simultaneously perform the three common retrieval functionalities of embedding model: dense retrieval, multi-vector retrieval, and sparse retrieval.

sources.title: BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Suggest to use bge v1.5, which alleviates the issue of the similarity distribution. Since we finetune the models by contrastive learning with a temperature of 0.01, the similarity distribution of the current BGE model is about in the interval [0.6, 1].

sources.title: Welcome to BGE! — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: Want to get familiar with BGE quickly? There are hands-on examples to run for embedder and reranker's inference, evaluation, and finetuning. Unfamiliar with some area, keywords or techniques of retrieval and RAG? We provide tutorials to teach you basic knowledge and coding tips. Interested in research topics that expanding from BGE and retrieval?
